Cut 2026-10-13 on Anthony's word ("merge 735 when green, then cut 0.83.4"). A patch with two parts.
- #735: the served capture-intent skill asks, before a structural addition, what could be taken away instead (via negativa, advisory, barbell-style, never from the record), so every design gets the question.
- #734: reflow2's site says in plain words what reflow2 is and isn't, along the human decision process, with a walkthrough of one design and a page on why.
No tool, argument or store schema moved. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
